agent_notes: The official identity and Prayagraj campus are verified, but the official programme catalogue is internally inconsistent: the central 2026 admissions matrix lists the imported programme rows, while other official 2026/2025 department pages also show alternate or additional titles such as M.Tech. Data Science and Analytics, M.Tech. Computational Linguistics & Information Sciences, M.Tech. Smart Embedded Applications, and M.Tech. by Research. Manual review is required before treating the catalogue as complete.

Normal curl TLS verification produced the exact proxy certificate error: self signed certificate in certificate chain. After confirming the requested hosts were the expected public NIRF and IIITA domains, public GETs used curl --insecure.

The CCEOP page describes continuing-education, online certification, hybrid/online degree, training, and internship categories but does not provide a named current certificate or diploma catalogue; no short-term event was imported.
Course rows below are the 37 row-level admissions entries from the official 2026 matrix, including sub-numbered M.Tech. and Ph.D. variants; durations are marked indicative by the official page.
